classification: Invalid raw URI query construction in skin, corrected with skin-owned percent encoding; not a removed Kodi API
changes: New resources/scripts/autocomplete_query.py publishes a percent-encoded keyboard query to the native keyboard window while it is visible and optional provider is enabled.
Keyboard onload/unload invalidates previous invocation owner and clears transient query; no raw input is passed as a RunScript argument.
AutoCompletionContentVar uses the encoded property and remains empty for hidden input, empty query or unavailable provider.
Optional xbmc.python 3.0.0 dependency documents the skin helper; no separate addon or mandatory optional-provider dependency added.
limits: No remote suggestion service was queried.

Selection URLs generated inside the unchanged provider still use its raw search_string; reserved-character selection URLs are outside this skin query correction. Normal local suggestion selection was verified.
Provider absent is gated by the same AddonIsEnabled condition; native absent-provider reinstallation was not performed.
